notes: The author picked the squishy factory over Shadow Isles, and that game is a tycoon: toys are produced over time, earn coins, and fund factory expansions, security upgrades and a prestige reset, so the number going up is the game and it is Simulation with no second genre doing real work. Shape is plot-isolated rather than the Tycoon preset's plot-shared because each of the six factories the author asked for belongs to one player and stealing only makes sense between separate holdings; I kept the preset's purchase gates, upgrades bazaar and circulation, since the substitution is only of shape. The author's answer that each factory is a walkable interior players enter and upgrade earns P3 outright. Deciding without a user: prestige is the rebirth pad, the toy machines are task stations, and the lockable doors, alarms and leaderboards have no option to land on, so they ride along as factory dressing rather than layout picks.
